# Test data

Every file here is written for this project, generated from public material
or copied from a public source under its license. Nothing is copied from
customer content or private repositories. `examples/` at the repository root
holds two packages built from `features/packages/toets` for people to try.

| Directory | Contents | Origin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valid/`, `invalid/`, `package/` | Small QTI 3 items, a test and a manifest, valid and with one deliberate error each | Written for this project |
| `additional-checks/docs/` | One document per [additional check](../docs/additional-checks.md), with a case that fires and one that passes | Written for this project |
| `additional-checks/expected.json` | The findings of the ISO Schematron reference implementation (lxml) for those documents | Generated by `additional-checks/reference.py` |
| `schematron/docs/` | 100 random QTI-like documents that fire 1EdTech's Schematron rules | Generated by `schematron/generate.py` from the public QTI 3.0 XSD, [`imsqti_asiv3p0_v1p0.xsd`](https://purl.imsglobal.org/spec/qti/v3p0/schema/xsd/imsqti_asiv3p0_v1p0.xsd) |
| `schematron/expected.json` | The findings of the reference implementation for those documents | Generated with lxml's `isoschematron` |
| `features/packages/toets/` | A realistic test: twelve items of different interaction types, two sections, a stimulus and an image | Written for this project |
| `features/php-qti3/` | Four packages, valid and invalid | Copied from [kennisnet/php-qti3](https://github.com/kennisnet/php-qti3/tree/0ba4f7839fd4a0657a1350fc6fb6168688ca9710/fixtures) @ `0ba4f78`, MIT; see `features/php-qti3/LICENSE` |
| `features/golden/` | The expected report for every feature test, and per-file results for the 1EdTech examples | Generated by `go test ./internal/feature -update` |
| `corpus/` (not committed) | The public 1EdTech QTI examples | Fetched by `make corpus` |

The comparisons and measurements in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
also use two public corpora that are not copied here; see
[Public test corpora](../CONTRIBUTING.md#public-test-corpora).
